description: This file contains the controller class 'Currency' for the OpenCart admin localization module. It manages the display, listing, and editing of currency data within the admin interface, including handling request parameters, generating URLs, managing breadcrumbs, and rendering views.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Controller class for managing localisation currency data in the admin panel, including listing, form handling, and refresh actions.

methods.description: Generates the list of currencies with sorting and pagination, returning the rendered view.

methods.description: Displays the currency add/edit form, pre-populating fields if editing an existing currency.
